## How it was tested / 怎么测的

## Checklist / 检查

- [ ] `go vet ./...`, `go test -count=1 ./...`, `cd web && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` and `make build` pass
- [ ] New or changed user-facing text is in both `en` and `zh-CN` (no hard-coded text)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or setup changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, internal URLs or customer data in code, tests or screenshots
